sourceSentences: Kassadin is permanently ghosted and takes 10% reduced magic damage.
Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at the target enemy that deals magic damage and disrupts their ongoing channels. He also gains a shield that absorbs magic damage for 1.5 seconds.
The shield is granted at the start of the cast time.

Kassadin empowers his next basic attack on-hit within 5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain range, deal increased bonus magic damage, and restore mana, with the restoration amount quintupled against champions.
Nether Blade will not grant mana if the attack is dodged or if it misses, but will do so if the attack is blocked.
Each time Kassadin or a nearby champion casts an ability, Force Pulse's current cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds.
He then gains a stack of Riftwalk for 15 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 4 times. For each stack, Riftwalk deals bonus magic damage at an increased mana cost.
Flash can be used during the cast time, allowing Kassadin to blink further away.
Pinging Riftwalk will additionally display the remaining duration of its stacks.

For combos, your basic go-to is to Q into E before attacking into your auto attack reset of W. From here, just attack away. And your all-in is to ultimate into attack and reset with W. From here, E and Q before attacking away, ultting whenever you can.
you can even get away with overextending with so many jumps over so many walls. Wait until the fight starts, then alt over terrain onto the enemy backline.
If you can slow down and approach, do an auto attack, W, then Q and move away with R. that's the combo.
Now I'm standing by the wall because I can go through it with the rift-ox.
throw a Q at me, I'm going to try to block it with my Q.
La première c'est le R flash. Si vous voulez tuer quelqu'un, faites pas flash R, d'accord ? Vous mettez là et vous faites R flash surprise, c'est beaucoup mieux.
mon que cancelle les canalisations. Ça veut dire que si quelqu'un TP devant vous, par exemple, vous lui mettez un cpel, ça cancelle sa TP.
